001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.inventory;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.QSCancellable;
005import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
006import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
007import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
008import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
009import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
010
011/**
012 * Calling when previewing a Shop item
013 */
014public class ShopInventoryPreviewEvent extends AbstractQSEvent implements QSCancellable {
015
016  @NotNull
017  private final ItemStack itemStack;
018
019  @NotNull
020  private final Player player;
021
022  private boolean cancelled;
023  private @Nullable Component cancelReason;
024
025  /**
026   * Called when player using GUI preview
027   *
028   * @param player    Target plugin
029   * @param itemStack The preview item, with preview flag.
030   */
031  public ShopInventoryPreviewEvent(@NotNull final Player player, @NotNull final ItemStack itemStack) {
032
033    this.player = player;
034    this.itemStack = itemStack;
035  }
036
037  @Override
038  public @Nullable Component getCancelReason() {
039
040    return this.cancelReason;
041  }
042
043  @Override
044  public void setCancelled(final boolean cancel, @Nullable final Component reason) {
045
046    this.cancelled = cancel;
047    this.cancelReason = reason;
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Gets the ItemStack that previewing
052   *
053   * @return The ItemStack
054   */
055  public @NotNull ItemStack getItemStack() {
056
057    return this.itemStack;
058  }
059
060  /**
061   * Gets the Player that open gui for
062   *
063   * @return The player
064   */
065  public @NotNull Player getPlayer() {
066
067    return this.player;
068  }
069
070  @Override
071  public boolean isCancelled() {
072
073    return this.cancelled;
074  }
075}
